default_locale_help: Used when a person has not chosen a language.
description: Project-wide settings such as the service name and logo.
error_forbidden: You do not have permission to do this.
error_invalid_color: Enter the accent color in #rrggbb format.
project_logo_help: Drag and drop an image, or click to choose one. Leave it empty to fall back to the environment variable, or to text only.
project_name_help: Shown in the header, the login screen and the browser tab.
public_note_help: Shown on the login screen. Signed-out visitors can read it, so do not put secrets here.
reset_hint: Clear a field and save to fall back to the environment variable or the built-in default.
title: Settings
shortcuts_description: Set a key combination for each operation. Shortcuts are unset initially.
shortcut_duplicate: That key is already assigned to another operation.
shortcut_editor_conflict: That key conflicts with a text editing command.
smtp_priority_help: Values saved here take priority over environment variables. Environment variables are used as initial values only when no value is saved here. You can send a test email before saving.
smtp_host_help: The host name of the SMTP server.
smtp_user_help: The username used to authenticate with the SMTP server.
smtp_password_help: Enter this only when changing it. Saving it empty keeps the saved password.
